Definition
Source: topping:page-0109, topping:page-0110 1. ch9:4.4,ch9:4.5\group curvature-pinching The pull-back of the Einstein tensor is the section $\widetilde E\in \Gamma (V^*\otimes V)$ determined by \[ u(\widetilde E(v))=E(u(v)). \] It is an $h$-symmetric endomorphism and obeys the evolution equation for $E$, with $A(t)$ replacing $\nabla $.
